summary: Iteration 84 verifies new Documents tab re-upload flow and Shipments-only header actions. FOUND & FIXED a TypeScript compilation bug in the new re-upload handler (line 459) that was blocking ALL page rendering; after fix, every requested flow PASSES with 0 console errors and 0 horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 and 390x844.

ui_bugs.issue: TS2554 compile error: `update(s.id, (x)=>...)` in is-packing-reupload onChange — inside Detail component `update` is a prop bound to the shipment id and takes ONE argument. This broke the entire app (webpack overlay shown, no route mounted). Fixed by testing agent (aligned with the sibling booking-doc uploader at line 419).

verification_details.open_orders_row_expand: is-oo-row-P0159 expands; is-order-create-P0159 opens modal (New shipment prefilled Grupo Gardea SA DE CV)

action_items: The typo `update(s.id, (x)=>...)` at IntlShipmentsPage.tsx line 459 was fixed by the testing agent to unblock testing. Main agent should acknowledge / keep the fix; the 1-line change simply aligns with the sibling upload handler at line 419.

(Carry-over from iter 83) is-modal (New shipment / order-create) still lacks an Escape-to-close handler — the is-backdrop element intercepts pointer events. Consider adding shared overlay Escape handler.

Could not find a `.is-quote` element on mobile chat DOM — clamp may be class-scoped elsewhere. Visually messages render cleanly with no overflow but explicit verification of the 'clamp' selector was inconclusive; consider adding data-testid=is-msg-quote if a quoted reply visual needs verification.
critical_code_review_comments: The re-upload handler duplicates the booking-doc uploader logic at line 419 (both do `update((x)=>({...x, ...activity: [{...}, ...x.activity]}))`) — consider extracting a small `appendActivity(x, entry)` helper.

IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 486 lines (near recommended split threshold). Extracting `Detail` and `IntlOpenOrders` interactions into own files would have caught the update-arity typo at TS-check time in isolation.

The Detail component receives `update` as `(fn) => update(open.id, fn)` and its inner call was passed 2 args — this is exactly the kind of prop-arity slip that TypeScript catches; the compile error masked the whole page. Regression test needed: a smoke test that boots the SPA and asserts intl-shipments-page renders (i.e., compile error surfacing).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter 84: A single-char typo (extra `s.id` arg on the new is-packing-reupload handler) caused a full-app TS compile failure — always screenshot the login/root route first to detect webpack error overlays. After fixing, all iter-84 features work: Docs re-upload changes filename in is-packing-download label and prepends 'Packing list re-uploaded' entry to is-activity. Header actions (is-factories/is-controls/is-new-shipment) exist only on Shipments tab. Open Orders retains 4 KPI tiles and the P0159 row expand + is-order-create modal. Modal still lacks Escape-to-close (backdrop intercepts pointer events). 0 overflow at 1920 and 390.
rca of the issue: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx line 459 called `update(s.id, (x)=>...)` inside the Detail component. In Detail, `update` is a prop bound at line 116 as `update={(fn) => update(open.id, fn)}`, i.e., arity 1. TypeScript reported TS2554 'Expected 1 arguments, but got 2', CRA displayed a full-screen compile overlay, and the React tree never mounted (login form still visible but rest of app unreachable). Reproduction: navigate to root -> observe overlay. Mitigation: changed to `update((x)=>...)` matching sibling uploader at line 419.
